description.p: Mailin is a native desktop email client for IMAP and SMTP. It keeps a local SQLite cache for offline reading and stores passwords in the system keyring.

The Linux client is built with GTK 4 and libadwaita, renders HTML mail in a sandboxed WebKit view, blocks remote content until you allow it, and supports attachments, composition, replies, forwarding and desktop notifications.

Milestone 7: Windows packaging (self-contained zip, MSIX, Inno Setup installer), supply-chain hardening (cargo-deny), HTML policy edge-case tests, secrets as SecretString end-to-end, accessibility (GTK: a11y labels, keyboard nav, shortcuts overlay; WinUI: keyboard accelerators), CONDSTORE CHANGEDSINCE flag-delta sync with fallback.
First milestone 4 build: HTML mail, attachments, compose, notifications.
